description: Larger, more conventional battles against enemies equipped with armored vehicles, including a battalion-sized encounter in southwest Asia (p. 10 fn 12).
name: Conventional armored battle
rationale: The Army simulated it: a battalion-sized encounter in southwest Asia is among the scenarios CBO reports (p. 10 fn 12), and it is where the GCV's reduction in losses was smaller than against unconventional threats (p. 10).
